name: Big Ice trek on Perito Moreno Glacier
region: Los Glaciares National Park, Perito Moreno sector
why: The only long walk on the Perito Moreno: three hours of crampons among blue crevasses, deep in the ice.
book: Only as a guided excursion with the park's ice-trek operator, booked ahead; the operator sets age and fitness limits. Park entry fee paid separately at the park gate. A boat from Bajo de las Sombras pier, 70 km from El Calafate, crosses Brazo Rico in 20 minutes; the whole day takes about 12 hours with transfers.
water: Carry 1.5 litres and lunch: there is half an hour for lunch and nothing to buy on the ice side.
dangers: Crevasses and sinkholes: stay behind the guides, in their track.
Two hours on rough moraine before the ice, the same back: it is a hard day.
Sun glare off the ice: sunglasses and sun cream.
turnaround: The guides decide; the boat back leaves at a fixed time.

points.name: Brazo Rico landing, boat from Bajo de las Sombras
points.note: The boat from Bajo de las Sombras pier lands here, on the south shore facing the glacier. Guides brief the group at the shelter.

points.name: Moraine along the glacier's south edge
points.note: About two hours over moraine and through forest beside the ice; crampons, harness and helmet go on at the edge.

points.name: Perito Moreno ice field
points.note: On the ice for about three hours, in groups of up to ten with two guides: seracs, blue crevasses and meltwater pools.
